findings.claim: The required `npm ci` verification for agent tooling cannot succeed because the hook package adds dependencies without committing a package lockfile.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 3.1 requires the agent-tooling workflow to run `npm ci`; the diff adds `.claude/hooks/package.json` with `devDependencies` for `@types/node` and `typescript`, but no `.claude/hooks/package-lock.json` is added in the package area of the diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `npm --prefix .claude/hooks install --package-lock-only` or `npm --prefix .claude/hooks install`, commit `.claude/hooks/package-lock.json`, and verify `npm --prefix .claude/hooks ci` succeeds.
